summary: Two tests keep names for checks this change deleted: binding_refusals_are_errors_and_keep_their_cause no longer asserts the cause (the source() line went), and an_unknown_option_hint_lists_what_the_leaf_takes_... no longer asserts the hint lists the options (only error.expected does).
